$comment: The machine-readable side of the evidence scoreboard.
This file exists because on 2026-09-10 docs/GUARANTEES.md, whose entire job is not to
outrun its evidence, carried two false figures at once. It said the direction favoured
the engine on a comparison the engine was never in, and it carried a p99 range from an
uncommitted bench run that the 2026-07-16 amendment had already retired in the paper and
never here. Two months, on the public page, with nothing watching.
The root cause was not either figure. Claims cite evidence files, and nothing checked
that the number written in the prose was still the number in the file. The docs:refs gate
in the SaaS checks that citations RESOLVE, meaning the path exists, and a path that exists
with a number that changed passes green.
So each claim below carries `figures`, strings that MUST appear verbatim in the scoreboard,
and `retired`, strings that must NOT. The first half catches a page that lost a current
number; the second catches a page still carrying one that was withdrawn. Both failures
This file is PUBLIC on purpose. research/ is private and check-private forbids anything
public pointing there, so the private side feeds this registry through a script and the
public page only ever reads the registry.
